title: Import-reconciliation journal hardening: id rules on every id/ref field, descriptor count before materializing, observer field rows
outcome: The host import-reconciliation journal applies one bounded printable-identifier rule to every id and reference field, refuses an oversized persisted journal before materializing its units, and counts journal unit writes in the persist observer's per-field rows.
acceptance: Import-reconciliation journal hardening: id rules on every id/ref field, descriptor count before materializing, observer field rows is done
